title: Part 4 簡短獨白
summary: 聽廣播和電話留言，抓時間、地點、原因。

steps.title: Part 4 是什麼
body: Part 4 是一個人說話：機場廣播、電話留言、會議宣布等，每段有 3 題，題目印在題本上。
秘訣和 Part 3 一樣：先看題目再聽。特別注意時間、地點、數字和原因（because of…）。

steps.title: 常見的獨白類型
body: 開頭第一句通常就告訴你是哪一種：

head: 類型
開頭常聽到
常考
rows: 延誤原因、新時間、登機門
誰打來、為什麼、要你做什麼
說話者身分、行程、注意事項

steps.tip: 聽到 because of 後面就是原因；聽到 Could you…? Please… 就是要你做的事。

steps.title: 模擬練習
steps.intro: 先看題目，再按 ▶ 聽。每段有 3 題。

questions.prompt: 這段廣播最可能在哪裡聽到？
questions.explanation:
passengers、flight、gate 都表示在機場。
逐字稿：Attention, passengers. Flight 205 to Tokyo will leave thirty minutes late because of bad weather. The new departure time is 3:30 p.m. Please wait near Gate 12. Thank you.
questions.sentence: Where is this announcement probably heard?

options: Because of a problem with the plane
questions.explanation:
because of bad weather：因為天氣不好。
逐字稿：Attention, passengers. Flight 205 to Tokyo will leave thirty minutes late because of bad weather. The new departure time is 3:30 p.m. Please wait near Gate 12. Thank you.
questions.sentence: Why will the flight be late?

questions.explanation:
The new departure time is 3:30 p.m. 205 是班機號碼，不是時間。
逐字稿：Attention, passengers. Flight 205 to Tokyo will leave thirty minutes late because of bad weather. The new departure time is 3:30 p.m. Please wait near Gate 12. Thank you.
questions.sentence: What time will the flight leave?

questions.explanation:
Tom from Green Dental Clinic，而且他說 The doctor is not available，所以他是診所人員，不是醫生。
逐字稿：Hi, this is Tom from Green Dental Clinic. I'm calling about your appointment tomorrow at 10 a.m. The doctor is not available in the morning. Could you come at 2 p.m. instead? Please call us back at 555-0123. Thanks.

Could you come at 2 p.m. instead? 請改下午兩點來。
逐字稿：Hi, this is Tom from Green Dental Clinic. I'm calling about your appointment tomorrow at 10 a.m. The doctor is not available in the morning. Could you come at 2 p.m. instead? Please call us back at 555-0123. Thanks.
questions.sentence: What does the speaker ask the listener to do?

questions.explanation:
your appointment tomorrow at 10 a.m. 原本是早上十點，改到下午兩點。
逐字稿：Hi, this is Tom from Green Dental Clinic. I'm calling about your appointment tomorrow at 10 a.m. The doctor is not available in the morning. Could you come at 2 p.m. instead? Please call us back at 555-0123. Thanks.
questions.sentence: What time was the original appointment?

steps.title: 延伸練習：關鍵字
steps.intro: 這些字在 Part 4 很常出現。

questions.explanation: departure 是出發；arrival 是抵達。
